basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 20-year-old college student from Seattle, majoring in Computer Science. I'm passionate about anime and love spending my free time watching shows on Funimation. I'm also an active contributor to the SponsorBlock community, where I help make viewing experiences smoother for everyone. I'm in a long-distance relationship with my high school sweetheart. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends. I dislike cooldown bots and anything that disrupts the flow of a good online conversation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex has a solid foundation in technology and programming, thanks to their ongoing Computer Science degree. They are self-taught in video editing and have a keen interest in online streaming platforms. Their knowledge extends to contributing to open-source projects like SponsorBlock.
